g.title: capital-flow
g.text: Capital flow: how funds reach an agent, what it may spend on, and what it may never do
Only the owner's own funds enter. The agent account is the custody boundary. Nothing here creates capital.
Implemented, off or not yet run on testnet
Designed, not built or not deployed

g.title: ramp
g.text: USDC on Monad mainnet, destination set by API
flow not built, vendor terms unverified

g.title: relay
g.text: EIP-3009 authorization signed by the owner
relayer pays gas, per-user daily count
no relayed transfer executed on testnet yet

g.title: acct
g.text: sole custody boundary of the agent
principal = owner deposits minus owner withdrawals

g.title: trade
g.text: per-tx cap and rolling daily cap

g.title: never
g.text: Pay an address of its choosing
transfer or approve of USDC must name the
Kuru router or the reallocation contract
no native MON value in any call

g.title: indexer
g.text: counts only finalized Transfers of the

g.title: x402
g.text: EIP-3009 payment to a listed payee
at most 26 x paymentsPerEpoch x maxValue
per 24 hours, on top of the daily cap

g.title: gas
g.text: sponsored up to a per-agent budget,
then paid in MON by the account

g.title: realloc
g.text: one debit per source per evaluation, under the
owner's signed policy; switch is off by default

g.title: other
g.text: or create a new account to receive it

g.title: retired
g.text: a retired balance stays in its own account
